'''Enarc''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].

==Description==
Enarc was a major tradeworld located at the conﬂuence of several [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlanes]] that connected Mid Rim worlds between the [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]] and the [[Corellian Run/Legends|Corellian Run]].<ref name="FaDCR" /> It was an endpoint of the [[Enarc Run/Legends|Enarc Run]] and a jumping-off point of trade and travel to the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="TSoK" />

==History==
During the [[New Sith Wars]], the planet was the site of a [[Battle of Enarc|battle]] won by the [[Brotherhood of Darkness/Legends|Sith]].<ref name="TEA" />

Enarc was a [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] regional headquarters.<ref name="FaDCR" /> It was a distribution center, and [[Lucrehulk-class LH-3210 cargo freighter/Legends|''Lucrehulk''-class LH-3210]] cargo [[Freighter/Legends|freighters]] surrounded the planet. In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], Enarc served as the staging area for the [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] of [[Lucrehulk-class battleship|battleships]] led by the [[Saak'ak/Legends|''Saak'ak'']] that were sent to [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|blockade]] the planet [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].<ref name="TEGtW" />

In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], Enarc was controlled by [[Customs Vizier]] [[Marath Vooro]], who refused to acknowledge the authority of Acting [[Viceroy/Legends|Viceroy]] [[Sentepeth Findos]] and would not cooperate with the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Imperialization/Legends|nationalization]] of the Trade Federation.<ref name="HoloNet">{{InsiderCite|84|Republic HoloNet News Special Inaugural Edition 16:5:241}}</ref> His forces were [[Battle of the Hook Nebula|defeated]] that same year by an Imperial fleet during the [[Five Veils Campaign]].<ref name="TEGtW" /> The Empire eventually nationalized the Trade Federation assets on Enarc and transformed it into an [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] transport and supply command.<ref name="FaDCR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Enarc's location, until recently, was difficult to ascertain. [[Twin Stars of Kira (sourcebook)|''Twin Stars of Kira'']] indicated the world was near space strongly influenced by the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]], but ''[[Secrets of Naboo]]'' indicated it was near [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' reconciled these facts, placing it near Naboo but establishing the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]] had created a de facto enclave on the Enarc Run.
